Container.Name: Harmonicast
Container.Overview: Self-hosted collaborative Plex music jukebox with shared playback, requests, Track Radio, web, Android, Android Auto, and kiosk mode. On first launch, sign in with the Plex account that owns the server and choose its Music library.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser-facing Harmonicast URL, without a trailing slash. Required for the Plex sign-in return URL.

Config.Name: Plex client identifier
Config.Description: Optional stable Plex client ID. Leave blank to generate and persist one automatically.
